query: At which level(s) will we cluster standard errors, how will we adjust for serial correlation in annual outcomes, and will we pre-specify wild-bootstrap for few clusters?

response.query: At which level(s) will we cluster standard errors, how will we adjust for serial correlation in annual outcomes, and will we pre-specify wild-bootstrap for few clusters?
response.answer: Cluster standard errors at the annual level; adjust for serial correlation using Newey-West correction; pre-specify wild-bootstrap for few clusters.
